name: Tabby
tagline: Self-hosted AI coding assistant server delivering low-latency inline code completion for teams and solo developers.
real_test_summary: Tested running the Tabby server locally paired with StarCoder and Qwen2.5-Coder models in VS Code. Delivers fast ghost-text autocomplete with repository-level context indexing.
pros: Dedicated fill-in-the-middle autocomplete server with low latency
Extensions available for VS Code, JetBrains, Vim, and Neovim
Single binary or Docker deployment with built-in repo context indexing
cons: Focused primarily on autocomplete rather than autonomous multi-file agent edits
Requires running a persistent background server process
